title: EscrowCreate
key_points: The EscrowCreate transaction creates an escrow holding funds for a specified recipient until a later time or condition.
It requires a signature from the payer and can include multiple currencies in the held amount.
The escrowed funds are released to the recipient once the specified condition is met, such as a timestamp or additional signatures.
EscrowCreate transactions are recorded on the XRP Ledger and can be tracked by their unique transaction ID.
limitations: This documentation provides general information and may not cover all specific use cases and edge cases.
asserts: The EscrowCreate transaction allows for secure holding of funds in an escrow until a specified condition is met, enabling trustless transactions between parties.
scope: Describes the functionality and usage of the EscrowCreate transaction type within the XRP Ledger protocol.
